question: Should this PR stay blocked until redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof is supplied, or may maintainers accept the source-only timing evidence?
rationale: The code path is plausible and focused, but automation cannot prove the contributor's real Feishu or production-runner environment, and the diff changes session-state timing at a synthetic-result boundary.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result persists without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

options.title: Accept source-only timing risk
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally merge based on source and focused tests, while owning that the reported Feishu path was not proven on this PR head.

options.title: Pause behind canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 if no one can produce real transport or production-runner proof.
